Tiny Computers turns your iPhone Duo into miniature machines inspired by decades of computing. Fold your phone and spend a little time with your old favourite — or the computer your parents grew up on.

Out 23 October, the same day as iPhone Duo.

Tiny Computers is available on the App Store now.

summary: If you’ve got or get a Duo and don’t try this out, you’re not hooked up right. Update: But as Cabel Sasser notes , though incredibly fun, this was clearly made by a young Claude-aided developer who never used any of these actual old computers. Let’s just say there are a lot of ahistorical details. ★
title: Tiny Computers for iPhone Duo
